[[Talon Karrde]] operated an '''asteroid base''' in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Originally discovered by his associate, [[Quelev Tapper]], Karrde made use of the mined-out asteroid after Tapper's [[Quelev Tapper's organization|organization]] merged with his [[Car'das/Legends|own]].
